tool_input.result: Implemented and tested the full workflow as per user requirements. The workflow triggers manually, reads commercial entries from Google Sheets, calculates profit, classifies each entry using AI, sends formatted messages to Slack, generates reminder emails for 'to Business' entries using AI, and sends emails via Gmail to the corresponding managers. All actions have proper parameters and the workflow handles data transformations and AI output parsing correctly. The workflow ran successfully with all tested data.
